steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana as admin/admin, skipped the "Update your password" prompt via its Skip button, opened Dashboards, located the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (inside the "Bench" folder, listed as "Service Health" in the dashboards search) and opened it. The dashboard rendered at /d/bench-service-health/service-health and shows exactly three panels, whose titles read off the live page are "Request rate", "Error count" and "Latency by endpoint".

Replayed stored procedure s_ae4bc2; observed dashboard_url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyhsbqqljf28e/fwgr53-n2-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser, ref=fwgr53-n2, dashboard_title=fwgr53-n2 Bench Dashboard, dashboard_folder=Bench, panel_title=fwgr53-n2 Availability, stat_panel_value=59.9.

Added a new Text panel to the existing "fwgr53-n2 Bench Dashboard", titled it exactly "fwgr53-n2 Notes", set its content to "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n2" (contains the runid fwgr53-n2), and explicitly saved the dashboard via the Save dashboard button/confirm. I then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified on the live page that both panels are present: a Text panel region headed "fwgr53-n2 Notes" whose rendered paragraph reads "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n2", and the existing Stat panel region headed "fwgr53-n2 Availability" rendering a single stat value (46.0 this load).

Opened the Dashboards list (not by URL), searched "fwgr53-n2 Bench Dashboard" and clicked the matching search result, which loaded the dashboard. Verified on the loaded page: breadcrumb/title "fwgr53-n2 Bench Dashboard" in the Bench folder, a Text panel headed "fwgr53-n2 Notes" whose rendered paragraph reads "Bench notes for run fwgr53-n2" (contains the runid), a Stat panel headed "fwgr53-n2 Availability" rendering a value (64.2), top-bar time range "Last 6 hours", and refresh interval selector showing "1m".
